title: trail
needAppBody: Browser location stops the moment the page goes to the background, so a day recorded in a tab is a day full of holes. The installed app runs a foreground service instead, and keeps going with the screen off.
oldAppTitle: The app is older than this page
oldAppBody: Reinstall it from the About tab and this screen will record.
needGrantBody: Android gives "while using the app" from a dialog. "All the time" comes only from settings, and that is the one a day needs.
lostBody: Taken by the service while this screen was gone. Drawn as a gap rather than guessed at.
legend: A dot stayed home, blank was never recorded — and the whole month is drawn at one scale.
atHomeBody: Recorded, and never more than a few steps from one place.
emptyBody: Start a day on the first tab. Each one becomes a single mark here.
deleteBody: The track and the poster drawn from it. This cannot be undone.
profTagline: Your day, recorded by the phone and drawn as one line. A month becomes a sheet where a long day looks long. Everything stays on your phone.
installDesc: Works offline, opens like an app
installIosHint: In Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: In the browser menu choose Install or Add to Home Screen.
